name: Cloud Boots
body:
School transmutation [air]; Level druid 5, shaman 5

Casting Time 1 standard action

Components V, S, DF

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)

Target one creature

Duration 1 hour/level (D)

Saving Throw Reflex negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

You form boots out of cloud-material around the target’s feet. These clouds allow them to move up or down in the air at a speed of 30 feet, laterally with a speed of 60 feet (perfect), and hover. The target cannot get more than 90-feet off the ground.

If the spell ends or is dismissed while the target is in the air, they fall to the ground as if affected by feather fall.

The target can dismiss this spell and walk normally by shaking the cloud-material off their boots.
